name: bu_Ca2C2O6
title: CaCO3 (Ca2C2O6) crystal
description: Variable-cell crystal-structure prediction of CaCO3 with two formula units (10 atoms) per cell: planar CO3 anions must assemble from random atoms. Experimental ground state: calcite (R-3c, 10-atom primitive cell); aragonite and vaterite are metastable. NEP89 caveats: the putative NEP89 global minimum is a vaterite-like layered polymorph (CO3 planes normal to the Ca layers, +6% volume) 7.4 meV/atom below calcite, and CaO + CO2 is only 0.32 eV/f.u. above calcite (exp. ~1.8 eV), a frequent trap.
